headline: Trabzonspor's 4-win run meets a rested Rizespor
summary: Trabzonspor go to Rizespor for the Black Sea derby having won their last 4 league matches, the best of them a 2-0 win over Beşiktaş on 19 October. Daily Sabah reports Mohamed Salah leads the Süper Lig with 8 goals, though coach Thomas Reis says Paul Onuachu is doubtful. Rizespor lost 0-3 at home to Fenerbahçe, but they have had 10 days to prepare. Even so, the market makes Trabzonspor 45.3% favourites against 29.6%, with the handicap close to level: Rizespor get a 0.25-goal start.
read: Trabzonspor are the market's favourites for the Black Sea derby at 45.3%, built on four wins in five, a 2-0 win over Beşiktaş and Mohamed Salah's eight goals in eight league rounds. Rizespor are 12th with one win in five but have had 10 days to prepare, and the market expects goals, with a 2.97-goal line and over 3.0 almost level.

facts.fact: Trabzonspor's last five read W-W-W-W-L, with 13 goals scored and 3 conceded.
facts.meaning: The away side comes in as the league's form team, scoring more than two and a half goals a game in that stretch.

facts.fact: Trabzonspor beat Beşiktaş 2-0 in the Süper Lig on 19 October, with Mohamed Salah scoring the second goal.
facts.meaning: The biggest result of their run came days before this trip, and confidence will be high for the derby.

facts.fact: Mohamed Salah leads the Süper Lig scoring charts with 8 goals in the opening 8 rounds, according to Daily Sabah.
facts.meaning: The league's top scorer is the single biggest threat to a Rizespor side that has kept one clean sheet in their last five.

facts.fact: Trabzonspor coach Thomas Reis said Paul Onuachu and Mustafa Eskihellaç will not feature against Hearts, and that Onuachu is doubtful for the Rizespor match.
facts.meaning: Trabzonspor may have to play the derby without their target man, which changes how they attack crosses and long balls.

facts.fact: Rizespor have won once in their last five, reading L-L-D-W-L.
facts.meaning: The home side comes into a derby with little momentum, and the market prices them as clear underdogs at home.

facts.fact: Rizespor lost 0-3 at home to Fenerbahçe on 10 October despite out-creating them 1.52 xG to 0.96.
facts.meaning: They are not being overrun at home — the problem has been converting and defending the few chances they allow.

facts.fact: Rizespor have had 10 days off since their last match.
facts.meaning: Fresh legs for the home side against a Trabzonspor squad in the middle of a European week.

facts.fact: The market's 50/50 goal total is 2.97 — close to three goals a game.
facts.meaning: An open derby is expected rather than a cagey one, with over 3.0 goals effectively a coin flip.

sources.fact: Trabzonspor beat fierce rivals Beşiktaş 2-0 in the Süper Lig, with Mohamed Salah scoring the second goal.
Trabzonspor coach Thomas Reis said Paul Onuachu and Mustafa Eskihellaç will not feature against Hearts, and Onuachu is doubtful for the Rizespor match.
Thomas Reis warned that Hearts' heavy 7-1 defeat to Celtic makes them dangerous, saying they will want to prove it was a mistake and show a strong response.
Trabzonspor are on a four-match winning run and are looking to extend it to five against Hearts, according to Daily Sabah.
Mohamed Salah tops the Süper Lig goal charts with eight goals in the opening eight rounds, per Daily Sabah.
Trabzonspor defender Stefan Savic believes his team can raise their level even further after beating Beşiktaş.
Rizespor host Trabzonspor in a Black Sea derby, with defender Modibo Sagnan speaking about the match.
Rizespor began preparations for the Trabzonspor match under coach Recep Uçar with passing and tactical work at the Mehmet Cengiz facilities.
